annotations.text:
Every colour, radius and border here is lifted from lib/theme.dart — brand #4BB8FA, surface #0D1218, raised #1A2630, muted #556070, 16px radii. The only thing that changes between a "today" board and its pair is TYPE.

The crest and avatar are stand-ins for the real artwork.
This one is not just type. It puts the opponent's running total on screen during the rounds — which needs a decision from you, since there is no server and their score is simulated up front.
